learning_outcomes.text: Students can discuss information technology fundamentals using various problems from mechanical engineering and mechatronics.
Students can explain the relevant methods for information acquisition, processing, and technical use.
Students can identify and discuss alternative methods for determining and describing uncertainties of measured quantities and their propagation in technical systems.
Students can describe information filters and fusion methods for information and explain their targeted use for given tasks.

syllabus_topics: Techniques of information and data processing in mechanical engineering
assessment_rules: Oral exams lasting approximately 5 minutes per ECTS credit point. The number, form, and scope of assessments may vary depending on the individual choice of module components.
